claude_proposed_widenings.name: dissolve_adhesive
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The item's core deterministic mechanic is removing adhesive coverage from a touched surface by area spent; no existing surfaced effect atom expresses that world-state change honestly.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Each ounce instantly dissolves up to 1 square foot of adhesive it touches, including Sovereign Glue.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: Attachment.surface_or_object
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Magic-item activations currently cannot attach to a non-creature surface/object target within reach.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: pour 1 or more ounces of solvent from the tube onto a surface within reach

claude_proposed_widenings.name: ClassFeatureActivationCost.utilize
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The item explicitly consumes the Utilize action, which is more specific than the existing generic action activation cost.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: You can take a Utilize action

claude_proposed_widenings.name: UseCountCap.random_initial_quantity
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The item's consumable pool is initialized randomly when found, which the current fixed/tiered/linear/proficiency/ability cap model cannot express.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: When found, a tube contains 1d6 + 1 ounces.
